description: When the actual return on Box 3 assets was lower than the notional return, the Belastingdienst taxes the actual return instead (following the Supreme Court rulings). For one tax year from 2017 to 2026 this compares the notional Box 3 tax with the tax on the actual return (interest, dividends, rent and value changes minus interest paid), and estimates the difference that could be refunded and which procedure applies to that year. Read-only calculation; it submits nothing and is not tax advice.

assessed_box3_tax.description: The Box 3 tax on the actual assessment, if known (more exact than the estimate)

dividends_and_rent.description: Dividends and net rental income received

fiscal_partner.description: Amounts are a fiscal-partner couple's total. Default false.

other_assets.description: Investments and other assets on 1 January

savings.description: Savings on 1 January of that year

value_change.description: End value minus start value of investments, corrected for purchases and sales (negative for a loss)

name: box3_actual_return_estimate
title: Box 3 actual-return comparison (2017-2026)
